description: Fetch a parsed TC39 clause as structured JSON: metadata, signature, algorithm steps, notes, cross-refs, and outward citations to external specs (Unicode, IETF, WHATWG). `spec` selects '262' (default) or '402'. `edition` defaults to `latest` (current stable release on both specs — es2026 today).

edition.description: Edition within the chosen spec. ECMA-262: es2016 … es2026, main. ECMA-402: es2016 … es2026, main. Aliases: latest, draft, next.

spec.description: Which TC39 spec to read: '262' (core language, default) or '402' (Internationalization API).

name: clause.get
title: Get spec clause
